description: Lists guests in the selected wedding who are recorded as 13 or older, with saved names, contact preferences (a "defaulted" list names any nobody chose), language, RSVP status and timestamps. Optional filters narrow results by RSVP status, language or name, and results can be ordered by name or by most recent update, RSVP reply or addition; per-status counts cover every listed guest before filtering. Guests under 13 or with unconfirmed ages are excluded, as are guest notes and dietary details. Requires sign-in.

language.description: Filter by a language name or code, such as Spanish or es. Empty string selects guests with no recorded language. Supported languages: English (en), Spanish (es), French (fr), Italian (it), German (de), Portuguese (pt), Polish (pl).

rsvp_status.description: Filter by RSVP status, one status or a list such as ["pending", "maybe"] for everyone yet to confirm.

search.description: Search guests by name. A first name, a last name, or the whole name all match, and accents are ignored, so Ines finds Inês.

sort.description: Order of the guests. "name" (the default) is last name then first. "recently_updated", "recently_responded" and "recently_added" put the newest first, by updatedAt, rsvpRespondedAt and createdAt; guests with no time sort last, by name.

wedding_id.description: Identifier of a wedding the signed-in account can manage. Required when the account has multiple weddings.

name: list_my_guests
title: List My Wedding Guests
